basic_details.short_information: National Ayurveda Research Institute for Panchakarma (NARIP), Cheruthuruthy, Thrissur, Kerala under the Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences (CCRAS), Ministry of Ayush, Government of India, has invited bio-data for engagement to 01 (one) post of Consultant (Biochemistry) purely on a contractual basis. Eligible candidates fulfilling the prescribed qualifications may forward their bio-data by email to [email protected] so as to reach the institute on or before 31.10.2026 by 05:00 PM.

qualification.details: Essential Qualification: Professionals having proven competency and success in their area of specialization (Biochemistry) with 5 years of post qualification experience and should possess minimum M.B.B.S./M.Sc (Medical Biochemistry). Weightage for Higher Qualifications: Ph.D. in the concerned subject will be considered as 4 years experience (irrespective of the duration taken to complete the degree). MD (Biochemistry) will be considered as 3 years experience. Age Limit: Upto 45 years. | Candidates should refer to the official notification for any further discipline-specific eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: About NARIP Consultant (Biochemistry)
content_sections.text: National Ayurveda Research Institute for Panchakarma, Cheruthuruthy, Thrissur is under the Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences, Ministry of Ayush, Government of India. The institute intends to engage 01 (one) Consultant (Biochemistry) on a contractual basis initially for a period of six months.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must forward their filled-in bio-data along with one recent passport size photograph and self-attested relevant certificates by email to: [email protected] The bio-data should be addressed to The Director (Institute), National Ayurveda Research Institute for Panchakarma, Cheruthuruthy, Thrissur District, Kerala-679531. The complete bio-data along with attachments must reach the institute latest by 31.10.2026 at 05:00 PM. The format for submission of bio-data may be downloaded from the Council's Website www.ccras.nic.in. For inquiries, candidates may contact Phone Office: 04884 - 262543, Hospital: 04884 - 262544, 45. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential Qualification: Professionals having proven competency and success in their area of specialization (Biochemistry) with 5 years of post qualification experience and should possess minimum M.B.B.S./M.Sc (Medical Biochemistry). Weightage for Higher Qualifications: Ph.D. in the concerned subject will be considered as 4 years experience (irrespective of the duration taken to complete the degree). MD (Biochemistry) will be considered as 3 years experience. Age Limit: Upto 45 years. Candidates should refer to the official notification for any further discipline-specific eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Filled-in Bio-Data in the prescribed proforma One recent passport size photograph affixed to the application form Self-attested copies of relevant educational and experience certificates

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on a contractual basis initially for a period of 6 months, which may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the competent authority based on the performance of the selected candidate and co-terminus with the sanction of Hqrs. The selected candidate will have no right to claim for continuation or regular appointment. The selected candidate will be intimated and have to submit a Police clearance certificate and an undertaking in the non-judicial stamp paper along with the joining report at the time of joining. Applicants should bring their Bio-Data along with the original certificates with a set of photocopies and one passport size recent photograph at the time of the walk-in-interview/written test. The Director (Institute), NARIP, Cheruthuruthy reserves the rights to postpone or cancel the interview, without assigning any reason thereof.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced in NARIP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 (one) vacancy announced for the post of Consultant (Biochemistry).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the bio-data?
faq.answer: The bio-data must reach the institute through email latest by 31.10.2026 at 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a minimum M.B.B.S. or M.Sc (Medical Biochemistry) with 5 years of post-qualification experience in the specialization area.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Consultant (Biochemistry)?
faq.answer: The age limit prescribed for the post is upto 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly remuneration for the post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed monthly remuneration of Rs.60,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is the engagement permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a contractual basis initially for a period of 6 months, which may be extended or curtailed based on performance and sanction of headquarters.

faq.question: Q7. How is Ph.D. or MD qualification counted towards experience?
faq.answer: Ph.D. in the concerned subject will be considered as 4 years experience, and MD (Biochemistry) will be considered as 3 years experience.

faq.question: Q8. What documents must be submitted at the time of joining?
faq.answer: The selected candidate must submit a Police clearance certificate and an undertaking on non-judicial stamp paper along with the joining report.
